annotations.title: Find newsletters, YouTube channels and podcasts to sponsor

description: Use this when a marketer, founder or media buyer asks which newsletters, YouTube channels or podcasts they should sponsor in a category (such as AI, tech, business, finance or marketing), or which creators have run ads for a specific brand. Returns active creators observed running paid sponsorships in the last 90 days, with their recent sponsors and public media kit URLs.

brand.description: Optional brand name or domain (e.g. linear.app or Shopify) to find creators who ran ads for that brand.

channel.description: Filter to one channel (newsletter, youtube, or podcast), or leave out for all three.

medium.description: Alias for channel (newsletter, youtube, or podcast).

niche.description: Creator topic: ai, business, finance, tech, marketing, health, culture, food, productivity, crypto, dev, design, science, education, sports, climate, media, local, legal, travel. Leave out for all topics.

q.description: Optional keyword search matching creator name or past sponsor brand.

name: find_creators_to_sponsor
title: Find newsletters, YouTube channels and podcasts to sponsor
